name: WfmCompetingAttemptReviewProposalAlgorithm
inputs: one immutable published valid wfm_service_provider observation
current LLD-03 canonical parent RFC identity
preconditions: observation identity is exact TK+14 under exact NC+14
planned_start and planned_end are both usable validated whole-second UTC instants with end>start
task_no_status is ACTIVE and get_by_task_no resolves one current WFM Task under the exact current parent RFC
subject Task already has reviewed activity-lineage authority; absence of reviewed lineage cannot produce this proposal
algorithm: if classification is not SAME_REVIEWED_LINEAGE_OVERLAP emit no wfm_competing_attempt_review

for each exact conflicting counterpart returned only through the provider-owned deterministic conflict iteration used to calculate the complete authority, emit one smallest-safe-scope proposal in canonical counterpart task_id order; implementations may stream this bounded proposal-generation pass and must not expose the complete conflict set in transport

each proposal uses proposal_kind=wfm_competing_attempt_review,risk=high,evidence_mode=observed_row,target_kind=activity_lineage,target_internal_id=activity_lineage_id,target_business_id=subject task_no,source_observation_id=the exact WFM observation,base_state_token_sha256=the complete conflict_fingerprint

each proposal contains exactly one ordinal-0 change {field_key:'competing_attempt_counterpart',change_kind:'conflict',value_kind:'identity',before_text:null,after_text:counterpart_task_id,before_integer:null,after_integer:null,source_observation_field_id:null}

proposal fingerprint is calculated by the ordinary LLD-04 immutable proposal fingerprint algorithm and therefore separately binds source observation/change/profile evidence; it must not encode an operator lineage decision

if a materially equivalent still-pending proposal for the same subject observation/activity_lineage/counterpart/base conflict fingerprint already exists, deterministic proposal generation reuses/no-changes according to the existing equivalence rules rather than duplicating review authority
rules: mere time overlap, same RFC, same Task Name, same Customer, same source status, or source-plan similarity never establishes same activity
ABSENT or RETIRED Task No, missing reviewed lineage, different lineage, blank/partial/malformed plan evidence, or locally terminal execution/outcome cannot emit this proposal

source projection acceptance and activity-lineage review are independent. A newly observed candidate interval may generate the review proposal, but dedicated resolution requires that exact source observation to have become the current accepted LLD-05 source projection before the review can be accepted
the complete conflict_fingerprint may bind more conflicts than the selected per-proposal counterpart; any relevant set/member authority drift stales every proposal derived from that fingerprint

proposal resolution never changes provider source evidence, WFM identity, operational plan, execution/outcome, Objective membership or TK identity except for LLD-05 lineage authority explicitly selected by the operator
